meta.title: End to End 2 of 2 - Deliver and Recover

views.label: Claim on the partition thread
views.note: Permit, then one claim transaction: lock, hold check, HELD or SENDING; offset after the claim (ADR-010 s2, s7).

views.label: Send on the target's bulkhead
views.note: Pinned mapping, checked address, six controls, attempt row, state change only with the claim token.

views.label: Retry and reconcile
views.note: The delivery-retry job re-drives RETRY_WAIT and runs the reconciler: nothing stays stuck (ADR-010 s9).

messages.label: claim tx: lock, hold check, HELD or SENDING
messages.note: Hold if an earlier same-key message is still ACCEPTED or an earlier delivery to this target is not final

messages.label: send to checked IP, layer-1 redelivery
messages.note: Timeout, transient-only redelivery (2 max, 5 s of delay), breaker, Retry-After honoured

messages.label: outcome class
messages.note: 500/502/504/408 are AMBIGUOUS unless the target declares idempotent receive

messages.label: attempt row + state if token matches
messages.note: Final state releases the next HELD delivery in the same transaction

messages.label: due RETRY_WAIT to DUE + outbox
messages.note: At half-open, at most the breaker's trial count per target

messages.label: reconcile: stale ACCEPTED, idle, HELD
messages.note: Re-publishes messages ACCEPTED over 5 min, PENDING/DUE idle over 5 min, HELD with no blocker

messages.label: stale claim: 3 x timeout + 65 s
messages.note: Classed AMBIGUOUS; a late outcome with an old token changes no state

cards.title: One slow target stays alone
items: Sends never run on the Kafka partition thread
A full bulkhead defers in the database, no call

cards.title: Exactly two retry layers
items: Layer 2: RETRY_WAIT rows, the delivery-retry job

cards.title: Nothing stays stuck
items: Release in the same transaction as the final state
Reconciler and consumer pause: 0 lost on a crash
